title: Plate Filling Heat Inactivated Covid Samples for PCR
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare plate layout and equipment
steps.instruction: Select the specified 96‑well plate (microamp I48HO or alternative) and mount the P20 multi‑channel pipette on the indicated side; leave wells A1 and A2 empty for the positive and negative controls, and assign sample wells starting at A3 across the row for the desired number of samples (1–94). Samples will be taken from tube‑rack slots 7, 8, 10, and 11 in that order.

steps.title: Add mastermix to sample wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 250 µL of mastermix into each well that will contain a sample (all wells from A3 onward according to the number of samples).

steps.title: Add heat‑inactivated COVID samples
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 250 µL of each heat‑inactivated COVID sample from the tube‑rack (slots 7, 8, 10, 11) into the corresponding wells, starting at A3 and proceeding across the row.
